인비저닝 임팩트 솔루션 투자조합 (Envisioning Impact Solution Fund)

strategy.thesis: Korea's first climate-tech-dedicated VC, spun out of impact pioneer Yellowdog in 2021. Invests around Series A in decarbonization across energy, mobility, circular economy/plastics, alternative protein and industrial emissions reduction.

summary.en: Envisioning Partners is South Korea's first dedicated climate-tech venture capital firm, founded in 2021 by the team that previously ran impact-VC Yellowdog. It raised the country's first climate-specialized fund (the Climate Solution Fund, ~667억원, entirely private capital) and a follow-on Impact Solution Fund (440억원), backing Series-A-stage decarbonization startups across energy, circular economy, alt-protein and industrial emissions.
summary.local: 인비저닝파트너스는 2021년 옐로우독 운용 인력이 출범시킨 국내 최초의 기후테크 특화 벤처캐피탈로, 전액 민간자금 667억원 규모의 '클라이밋 솔루션 펀드'와 440억원 규모 임팩트 솔루션 펀드를 운용하며 시리즈 A 전후 기후테크 스타트업에 투자한다.

funds.name: 임팩트 피크닉 투자조합 (Impact Picnic Fund 1, climate tech)
임팩트 피크닉 투자조합 2호 (Impact Picnic Fund 2, climate tech)
서울시 소풍 기후테크 투자조합 (Seoul Sopoong Climate Tech Fund)

strategy.thesis: Korea's first impact investor (est. 2008), now a full-lifecycle climate-tech investor under the 'ACT ON CLIMATE CRISIS' banner. Concentrates on the three highest-emission sectors — energy, circular economy and agri-food — investing >50% of fund capital into climate tech from seed through pre-IPO.

perks: IMPACT CLIMATE / Net Zero Challenge X program

summary.en: Sopoong Ventures, founded in 2008 as Korea's first impact investor and relaunched as an independent VC in 2019, has become a full-lifecycle climate-tech investor. It runs ~11 funds (AUM ~587억원) and a ~180-company portfolio, raised two dedicated climate funds (Impact Picnic 1 at 103억 and Impact Picnic 2 targeting 250억), and in its latest year invested 92.95억 across 18 startups with 58% in climate tech. It holds Korea's first climate-specialized TIPS license.
summary.local: 소풍벤처스는 2008년 국내 최초 임팩트 투자사로 설립돼 2019년 독립 투자사로 재출범한 뒤 기후테크 종합 투자사로 자리매김했다. 운용자산 587억원·11개 펀드·180여 개 포트폴리오를 운용하며, 103억원 규모 임팩트 피크닉 1호와 250억원 목표의 2호 기후테크 펀드를 결성했고 국내 첫 기후테크 특화 TIPS 운용사로 선정됐다.

strategy.thesis: Korea's first social-innovation consulting + acceleration + impact-investing firm (est. 2011). Invests in 'rule breaker / game changer' startups solving social and environmental problems, with dedicated green/ESG vehicles (e.g. Hyundai-Kimberly Green Impact Fund) and a K-RE100 renewable-energy commitment.

summary.en: MYSC (MY Social Company), founded in 2011, is Korea's first social-innovation consulting, acceleration and impact-investing firm. It registered as a specialized accelerator in 2018, began impact investing in 2013, and as of March 2025 managed ~910억원 AUM across multiple impact/ESG funds — including the Hyundai-Kimberly Green Impact Fund and a KB Securities ESG fund — with climate/clean-energy among its investment themes.
summary.local: 엠와이소셜컴퍼니(MYSC)는 2011년 설립된 국내 최초의 사회혁신 컨설팅·액셀러레이팅·임팩트투자 기관이다. 2013년 임팩트 투자를 시작하고 2018년 액셀러레이터로 등록했으며, 2025년 3월 기준 약 910억원의 AUM을 운용한다. 현대-킴벌리 그린 임팩트 펀드 등 그린·ESG 펀드를 통해 기후·클린에너지 분야에도 투자한다.

strategy.thesis: GS Group's domestic CVC (Korea's first holding-company CVC, est. Jan 2022). Makes direct early-stage (seed–Series B) investments in GS's strategic growth areas: climate-change response, resource circulation, new/renewable energy, bio and retail; partners with GS subsidiaries for later-stage rounds.

summary.en: GS Ventures is the domestic corporate venture-capital arm of GS Group, established 7 January 2022 as Korea's first CVC under a holding company (㈜GS, 100% owner, 100억원 capital). It invests directly at seed–Series B in GS's strategic growth themes, including climate-change response, resource circulation and new/renewable energy, alongside bio and retail. (Its overseas affiliate GS Futures, set up in San Francisco in 2020, separately invests in climate/energy startups abroad.)

summary.en: L&S Venture Capital, founded in 2006 and based in Seoul, is a generalist early/expansion-stage VC that explicitly invests in the green-energy sector — solar, wind, fuel cell, LED and EV — alongside electronics, telecom equipment, robotics and medical devices. It has made ~91 investments with 6 exits, focused on Seoul, Gyeonggi and Chungnam.
summary.local: 엘앤에스벤처캐피탈은 2006년 설립된 서울 소재 종합 벤처캐피탈로, 태양광·풍력·연료전지·LED·EV 등 그린에너지 분야에 명시적으로 투자한다. 전자부품·통신장비·로보틱스·의료기기 등에도 투자하며 약 91건의 투자와 6건의 회수 실적을 보유한다.
